title.narrative: ¿LEAN¿ Landscapes and Environmental Agility across the Nation

description.narrative: The EU Action LEAN - Landscapes and Environmental Agility across the Nation- sets to address barriers in selected landscapes across the savannah, high forest and transitional ecological zones of the country. The project will work with partners to catalyse systemic changes across three biodiversity significant and economically important landscapeswith the overall objective of conserving biodiversity, improving livelihoods, increasing climate change resilience and reducing emissions from land use changes in these landscapes.
